purpose: Deterministic live cross-domain integrity audit for the canonical skill corpus and its PQ acquisition endpoints.

checked_in_reverse_projection_sync.expected: exact equality with deterministic source_parallel_quests projection
checked_in_reverse_projection_sync.actual: validator now performs exact object equality before rewriting

interpretation: The live canonical skill corpus contains 246 explicit skill→PQ edges across 170 of the 186 PQ IDs.

The historical 244-edge invariant referenced by older handoff material is stale relative to the current canonical skill corpus and should not be used as a current truth without reconciling the two additional canonical endpoints.
This audit validates only relationships represented by source_parallel_quests in the current skill corpus; it does not assert that the 16 PQs without a skill endpoint have no skill rewards.

The existing pq-cross-domain-index contains many historical artifact references that no longer resolve in the live tree; those are tracked separately and are not silently deleted because they document prior work.
The live validator was hardened to compare the checked-in reverse artifact against the deterministic projection, preventing a count-only pass from masking per-PQ skill-ID/name drift.
A source-level syntax defect in the validator was detected and corrected in the live main branch; runtime execution remains intentionally unclaimed until the repository can be executed.

validator_hardening.correction: Repaired the malformed checked-in newline string in scripts/validate_skill_pq_crosslinks.py and retained the exact checked-in pq_ids projection comparison.
validator_hardening.expected_projection: Derived from docs/data/skills.json source_parallel_quests, including per-PQ skill_count, skill_ids, skills, and relationship_status.

validator_hardening_2026_09_26.change: Hardened validate_skill_pq_crosslinks.py to reject malformed canonical skill containers/records before projection: records must be a list of 474 objects with non-empty string id/name fields and source_parallel_quests must be a list when present.
validator_hardening_2026_09_26.result: No canonical skill→PQ relationship data changed; the established 474-skill / 246-edge / 170-represented-PQ projection remains the expected contract.

validator_hardening_reverse_metadata_202.change: Hardened validate_skill_pq_crosslinks.py to explicitly reject malformed checked-in reverse-index roots and drift in schema_version, scope, source, generated_on, canonical_skill_count, represented_pq_count, or total_skill_pq_edges before comparing the deterministic pq_ids projection.
validator_hardening_reverse_metadata_202.result: The established 474-skill / 246-edge / 170-represented-PQ contract and deterministic pq_ids projection remain unchanged.
validator_hardening_reverse_metadata_202.validator_commit: Committed directly to main in this continuation cycle; repository history is authoritative for the commit identifier.
validator_hardening_reverse_metadata_202.evidence_boundary: This validates the checked-in reverse artifact against its canonical skill projection; it does not infer rewards for PQs without explicit source_parallel_quests relationships.
